court_cases.status: Decided. Tribunal record describes the assessee as 'exclusively engaged in blending and packing of tea for export' — tea bags, tea in packets and bulk packs.

note: RISK-ONLY REVIEW. Treat non-US sanctions exposure as UNVERIFIED, not as cleared. Court cases: only income-tax and writ litigation found; no criminal case, no insolvency/NCLT matter, no sanctions-enforcement or export-control prosecution surfaced in Indian Kanoon. Per project rule 2 these are noted neutrally and are not rejection grounds. Regulator actions / negative news: no SEBI, DGFT, Customs, Tea Board or FSSAI action found; a targeted Indian Kanoon query for 'Narendra Tea' + customs/DGFT/SEBI/penalty returned zero results (https://indiankanoon.org/search/?formInput=%22Narendra%20Tea%22%20customs%20OR%20DGFT%20OR%20SEBI%20OR%20penalty). Absence of results is not proof of absence — mainstream news and regulator portals could not be searched. Credit rating: null — no CRISIL/ICRA/CARE/India Ratings/Acuite action publicly located; company appears to be an unrated SME, so no rating exists rather than a rating being withheld. RF/CIS supply evidence: null — no record found of supplies to Russia or CIS. The only export-related fact located is the ITAT Kolkata observation (24.05.2017) that the company blends and packs tea for export, which establishes an export orientation but names no destination country; it is not evidence of Russia/CIS trade. No shipment, B/L or customs record was retrieved, and none was invented. Caveat on identity: the batch lists the entity as 'M/s NARENDRA TEA CO. LTD' with legal name claimed as 'NARENDRA TEA COMPANY PVT LTD'; all court records above refer to 'Narendra Tea Company Private Limited' / 'Narendra Tea Co. (P) Ltd', Siliguri/Kolkata, West Bengal. Legal-identity confirmation is outside this role's scope and was not performed — the match is on name and geography only. Overall: no sanctions hit identified on the US list, no criminal or regulatory enforcement exposure found, litigation is tax and writ only. Residual risk is research-coverage risk (non-US lists and news unverified), not an identified adverse finding.
